title: 第7章  翻脸比翻书快
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

雪疙瘩捂在脚脖子上，秦淮茹又疼又冰。

“咝……”她连着吸了好几口气，眉毛揪成一团，眼睛眯缝着，嘴角直抽。

“忍一忽儿，马上就好！”李阳宽慰道。

秦淮茹嗯了一声，轻声说：“不打紧，今儿个可真要谢你了，要不我真不晓得咋收场了。”

李阳道：“瞧你这情形，没个两三天怕是下不了地……”

话音还没落地，秦淮茹就急了：“啊？那咋整？我跟婆婆说的明儿个就回。”

“她那脾气你也晓得，要是到点儿不回去，还不得把我骂化了？”

“李阳兄弟，你能不能帮姐拿个主意，明儿个说啥我也得回去，误不得。”

李阳缓缓摇了摇头，瞥了她一眼，回道：“老话说伤筋动骨一百天，你这脚崴得不轻，没那么快好利索。”

秦淮茹听了，脸一下子垮下来，心里头直发毛。

对她来说，婆婆贾张氏只要没被惹炸毛，一般也就动动嘴皮子骂人。

可她男人贾东旭就不一样了，稍有点不顺心，巴掌拳头就上来了，由不得她不害怕。

像她这样打乡下来的姑娘，能嫁进城里，那是祖坟冒青烟的事。

所以到了婆家，秦淮茹就算吃糠咽菜、当牛做马，也心甘情愿。

婆婆和男人待她再凶，她也不会顶嘴，只是担惊受怕是少不了的。

李阳见秦淮茹眨眼间眼皮子就红了，泪珠子在眼眶里直打转，心里暗叹这娘们真是天生的会来事儿。

不管秦淮茹在那头伤心，李阳也不劝了，蹲着身子，慢慢给她捂着脚。

过了一阵，敷完了脚，李阳起身搓了把毛巾，帮秦淮茹拾掇身上的泥点子。

“秦姐，甭愁了，实在没辙，你托个娘家人跑一趟城里捎个话呗。”李阳瞅她跟霜打了的茄子似的，忍不住拍了拍她肩膀，提点了一句。

秦淮茹摇摇头，叹了口气，说：“你不明白。”

“嗯，我是不明白。快把腰直起来，我帮你把这泥蹭了。”李阳托着她肩膀往上提了提，提醒道。

秦淮茹赶紧挺直了腰板，伸开两条胳膊，棉袄棉裤裹得圆滚滚的，活像只笨鹅。

李阳瞧着直想乐，上手帮她拾掇起来。

秦淮茹回过神来，狐疑道：“你乐啥？”

Page (1/3)

Snow knots covered her ankles, and Qin Huairu felt sore and ice-cold.

"Hiss..." She took several breaths in succession, her eyebrows knitted together, her eyes narrowed, and the corners of her mouth twitched.

"Be patient for a while, you'll be fine soon!" Li Yang comforted.

Qin Huairu hummed and said softly: "It doesn't matter, I really want to thank you today, otherwise I don't know how it would have ended."

Li Yang said: "Looking at your situation, I'm afraid you won't be able to get off the ground for two or three days..."

Before the words were spoken, Qin Huairu became anxious: "Huh? What about it? I told my mother-in-law that I would be back tomorrow."

"You also know her temper. If she doesn't go back, why don't you scold me?"

"Brother Li Yang, can you help me come up with an idea? I have to go back tomorrow no matter what. There is no mistake."

Li Yang slowly shook his head, glanced at her, and replied: "As the old saying goes, it takes a hundred days to break your muscles and bones. Your feet are very sprained, so you can't move so quickly and neatly."

After hearing this, Qin Huairu's face suddenly fell down, and her heart went crazy.

To her, her mother-in-law, Mrs. Jia Zhang, would usually just curse others as long as she wasn't offended.

But her man, Jia Dongxu, was different. If something didn't go his way, he would slap and fist him, and she couldn't help but be afraid.

For a girl like her who came from the countryside to marry into the city, it was a matter of smoke from her ancestral graves.

So when she arrived at her husband's house, Qin Huairu was willing to eat chaffy vegetables and work as a cow or a horse.

No matter how cruel her mother-in-law and men were to her, she would not talk back, but she would inevitably be frightened.

Li Yang saw Qin Huairu's eyelids turning red in the blink of an eye, and tears welling up in his eyes, and he secretly sighed in his heart that this girl was really born to do things.

Regardless of where Qin Huairu was feeling sad, Li Yang stopped trying to dissuade her. He squatted down and slowly covered her feet.

After a while, after applying it to his feet, Li Yang stood up, rubbed a towel, and helped Qin Huairu clean up the dirt on his body.

"Sister Qin, don't worry. There's really nothing you can do. Ask someone from your mother's side to go to the city to deliver a message." Li Yang looked at her like a beaten eggplant, and couldn't help but pat her on the shoulder and give her a few words.

Qin Huairu shook his head, sighed, and said, "You don't understand."

"Well, I don't understand. Straighten your waist quickly and I'll help you wipe away the mud." Li Yang reminded her by lifting her shoulders.

Qin Huairu straightened her back quickly, stretched out her arms, and was wrapped roundly in her cotton jacket and trousers, like a stupid goose.

Li Yang felt happy looking at it and started to help her tidy up.

Qin Huairu came back to her senses and asked suspiciously: "What do you enjoy?"
